_comment: List prices in USD per million tokens that the AI cost view (cveFeed.ai_usage.cost_by_stage_day) uses when no price was entered for a model on the AI Model Usage page; a price entered there wins. Edit this file to change a rate. cache_write_5m is 1.25x and cache_write_1h is 2x the input price; cache_read is 0.1x (0.05x on Sonnet 5.5). Haiku 5.5 doubles every figure for a prompt over 100,000 tokens, and no cvENGINE prompt is that long. The batch discount (50%) is not applied. Anthropic's invoice governs.
